title: oenothera gayophytum f. robusta
intro: Oenothera gayophytum f. robusta, commonly known as a variant of the Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Onagraceae family. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, calm digestive issues, and support menstrual health. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera gayophytum f. robusta include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), linoleic acid, and other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
